content: Pǝlǝa aburana mala Kiriat-Jarim yiu à yi twal Akwati kùrcau mala Yahweh; à wari nǝi a ɓala mala Aminadap mǝnana nda amúr mgbang-ban ngga. À twal muna-ɓwabura male Eleaza ɓǝ̀ do ndà mǝ'yál Akwati kùrcau mala Yahweh, ɓǝ̀ kǝ ɗenyinǝi.
Twal a pwari mǝno ka Akwati kùrcau mala Yahweh ue kano a Kiriat-Jarim banì sau kǝ̀rkǝ́r, pǝlǝa lumi-ɓari. Arǝ apǝlǝkia mǝno ka, amǝ Isǝrayila ɓua, ɓua keban mala alta Yahweh.
Samuyila duk mǝɓashi amur Isǝrayila
Sǝ Samuyila banggi ɓala mala Isǝrayila kat ama, <<Ɓǝ̀ wun nǝ̀ nyar aban Yahweh nǝ ɓabum wun kat ka, dumǝna púp wun nǝ̀ vwakibu wun arǝ abǝri ɓakuli andǝ aɓǝ̀nzál Ashtarot, ɓǝà pùrî ɓalǝ wun.
Wu pà ɓamur rǝ wun kat-kat aban Yahweh, sǝ wu peri abani nǝmurǝì, sǝ yì ka nǝ̀ amsǝ wun a ɓabu amǝ'Filisti.>>
Nda amǝ Isǝrayila yi pusǝki ankúl mala Ba'al andǝ Ashtarot à sukkia, sǝ à peri aban Yahweh nǝmurǝì ka.
Pǝlǝa Samuyila bang ama, <<Wu ram Isǝrayila kat a Mizǝpa sǝ mǝ nǝ pakhiwi aban Yahweh ace wun.>>

Lang à yi ramna a Mizǝpa ka, à tò mùr sǝ à solǝi a nzali a ɓadǝm Yahweh. A pwari mǝno kat ka, à gilmùr sǝ à bang nǝ kunia ama <<Sǝm pàngŋǝ́nì Yahweh cauɓikea.>> Samuyila yi do nda mǝɓashi amúr Isǝrayila a Mizǝpa.
Lang amǝ'Filisti ok ama amǝ Isǝrayila ramna a Mizǝpa ka, amurǝma mala amǝ'Filisti lo à yiu ace kánǝ munǝo arǝia. Sǝ lang amǝ Isǝrayila okce ka, ɓangciu pakkia wia arǝ amǝ'Filisti.
Sǝ amǝ Isǝrayila zǝmbi Samuyila ama, <<Lidǝmba nǝ ɓua ace sǝm aban Yahweh Ɓakuli ma'sǝm, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ amsǝ sǝm a bu amǝ'Filisti.>>
Pǝlǝa Samuyila twal muna-nzur mana nda a kúnkiura ka, pànà gir'nkila mala pisǝì kǝring nǝi a bǝsa aban Yahweh. Sǝ Samuyila ɓua aban Yahweh ɓǝ̀ bwalì amǝ Isǝrayila kàm, sǝ Yahweh ok ɓua male.

Lang Samuyila na aban pa gir'nkila mala pisǝe a bǝsa ka, amǝ'lwa mala amǝ'Filisti soa aban yiu nǝ munǝo arǝ amǝ Isǝrayila. Sǝama a pwari mǝno ka, Yahweh ìm arǝ amǝ'lwa mala amǝ'Filisti a kùli nǝ giu mǝcandǝe kǝla sa mala mgbarangce. Yahweh túriá aɓa múrzurǝkya, nda à ɓangŋa a ɓadǝmba amǝ'lwa mala amǝ Isǝrayila ka.
Sǝ aburana mala amǝ Isǝrayila purî ɓá Mizǝpa nǝ mire, à pǝrta amǝ'Filisti sǝ à kǝ wal-luia amur njar aban ká ɗār a ɓangŋaban mala Bet-kar.
Anzǝm mǝno ka, Samuyila twal nggea-tali sǝ yi kwaki anre Mizǝpa andǝ Shen, sǝ tunǝ lullǝ banì ama Ebeneza,
acemǝnana bang ama, <<Ba ado ka, Yahweh na pakka sǝm gbasha ka!>>
Anggo sǝ amǝ'Filisti ka à paria, sǝ à nyare à kútí ɗǝm a nzong-nzali mala amǝ Isǝrayila ama à nǝ̀ yiu nǝ lwa ɗang. Aɓa do-yilǝmu kat mala Samuyila ka, bù Yahweh ɓìkî amǝ'Filisti.

Amǝ'lwa mala amǝ Isǝrayila ak anggea-là mǝnana amǝ'Filisti ea arǝ amǝ Isǝrayila ka, à nyesǝia a bu amǝ Isǝrayila, twal a Ekǝron aban ká Gat. Acili abân mana tù nǝ anggea-là mǝnana amǝ'Filisti ea ɗiɗyal ka, amǝ'lwa mala amǝ Isǝrayila nyesǝia a bu amǝ Isǝrayila. Ɗǝm ngga do-rǝpwala yi pa a nreka amǝ Isǝrayila andǝ amǝ'Amor.
Samuyila lidǝmba nǝ do mǝɓashi amur amǝ Isǝrayila bà lú male.
Koya pǝlǝa ka kǝ twal gya aban ká andǝ nyare arǝ anggea-là Betel, andǝ Gilgal sǝ Mizǝpa. Pàkkî Isǝrayila ɓashi arǝ abân mǝnia ka kat.
Anzǝm mana malna ka, nǝ̀ nyar a Rama, ban mǝnana ɓala male pàk kàm ngga. A Rama gbal ka nda mǝɓashi, sǝ ɓakkî Yahweh gyangŋan kàm.

footnotes.text: Ebeneza ka ɓālǝi ka nda <<tali mala gbasha.>>
